name: Zack Space
summary: Zachary Thompson Space (born January 27, 1961) is an American lawyer and politician and the former U.S. representative for Ohio's 18th congressional district, serving from 2007 until 2011. He is a member of the Democratic Party.  After serving in Congress, Space became a lobbyist and was a principal for Vorys Advisors LLC, a subsidiary of the law firm Vorys, Sater, Seymour and Pease.
